items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: I met Bob Share then, who was provost for Berklee School of Music then.

ctx.x: But then you ended up at Berklee.

Well I taught privately, and in New York City for ten years or so. And I really wanted to make a move. I thought my musical life was starting to diminish there. I had the family and I was busy raising them and it seemed like everything I was doing took more and more energy to do and I wanted to get into a different area. So I had started I think the summer camps had been going on for about two years and I decided to sound around about getting into some kind of college teaching and I met Bob Share then, who was…
When you started at Berklee, how large a school was it?
